topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I woke this morn to find the place where I once planted a young tree now bare, the earth cut and the ground churned up. It was but a sapling when I was a lad, no taller than I, and I tended it with the same care I do my rows of barley. Seasons came and went, the tree grew as I did, and through the years, it stood tall, a marker of my youth. Now, where its branches once whispered to the saints, only silence. The air feels colder, the sky grayer. Someone saw fit to take what nature and I had built, and I cannot help but think on the winters to come, how the village will need all the warmth and shelter it can find.
